name: Mystic Tomato
source_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 DARK monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
notes: Recruits a DARK monster with ATK <= 1500 in face-up Attack Position.
